notes: PLEA on Sepolia (chain 11155111), contracts only: four application contracts deployed through the factory in constructor dependency order in one transaction, nothing called afterwards. Address words are EIP-55 checksummed. Order and arguments: (1) PLEA(owner) - sell-gated ERC-20, 1e9 supply with 18 decimals, minted once in init; owner is the address the brief names, 0x4b91078b2374c956A65F7Af0999CaE0a935E6821, written as a static word because the brief states it; the same address owns CabalGate (which reads plea.owner()), PleaDistributor and PleaHook. (2) CabalGate(plea, imd, oracleSigner) - takes 0.5 TestIMD per plea, emits the oracle request body with consumer {11155111, gate}, verifies EIP-712 attestations (domain IdentityMD Oracle v2, chainId 11155111, verifyingContract = gate) from signer 0x5598Aa9146215Bc13eb26f2c692Ad1461Fd32982 (owner can change it later via setSigner), executes approved sells inside the 7-minute window, handles appeals (0.85 TestIMD) and the 48h dead-man killCabal. (3) PleaDistributor(plea, owner) - Merkle claim contract for the 10% share; the owner sets the root once. (4) PleaLaunch(plea, gate, distributor, poolManager, imd, stacker) - last entry; its constructor reads plea.owner(), mines a CREATE2 salt on chain (salts 0,1,2... until the PleaHook address carries the hook flag bits in its low 14 bits, revert after 100,000 tries), deploys PleaHook{salt}(poolManager, plea, imd, stacker, owner) and calls PLEA.init(hook, gate, distributor), which records the three addresses, mints 90% to the hook and 10% to the distributor and calls hook.seed() to create the PLEA/IMD v4 pool (LP fee 0) at a 5,700 IMD market cap, PLEA only, with the hook as the sole and permanent LP. PleaHook is created by PleaLaunch and is deliberately not a manifest entry: the factory salt cannot hit its flag bits. Static arguments: Sepolia Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0xE03A1074c86CFeDd5C142C4F04F1a1536e203543, reused TestIMD 0x2B69099E59b05901faA1DD164fabf098bf831E82 and reused Stacker 0x293C7134Ab8f6Bf1D8fF44Ed806575f8F1bAF477 (imd/acc, none redeployed). TestSIMD 0xf9e2eec3b610ec6781f7438ac5fb4bc049d81cc1 is reached through the Stacker and is not a constructor argument. Rehearsal on an empty chain: PLEA.init also accepts a call in PLEA's deployment block (transient flag cleared between top-level calls), and seed() defers when the PoolManager has no code so every constructor still succeeds; on Sepolia the PoolManager exists and seeding happens inside the launch transaction. No token, pool, $token, reward distributor, ETH funding or initialization call: all wiring happens inside the constructors.
